en: Antique blue‑tinted postcard showing a large two‑storey academic building with a central arched entrance and Gothic‑style windows. People stand in the garden in front. Printed greeting at upper right reads in German, and a caption below identifies the building as the Evangelical regional church seminary. Publisher and printer credits run vertically at left. The reverse bears the Hungarian word for postcard, dotted address lines, and a purple round stamp of the Brukenthal Museum in Hermannstadt (Sibiu).
